title: GTA6 Shadows the Race: Phantom Blade Zero Wins October Game of the Month
description: As the gaming world anticipates GTA6, October 2026 brought a massive wave of PS5 releases. Discover Push Square's Game of the Month poll results.
author: GTA6 Hub Editorial
content:
## The Final Stretch Before GTA6: October's Massive Gaming Lineup

For gamers across the globe, certain periods on the calendar carry immense psychological weight. As noted recently by gaming outlet Push Square, October 2026 holds a very particular moniker among the community: the month before *GTA6*.

This temporal framing set the tone for an intensely busy 31 days of new PlayStation 5 releases. Following hot on the heels of an equally manic September, the industry found itself in a hyper-accelerated state. With Rockstar Games' monumental open-world epic looming large on the horizon, every release in this window carried extra significance as players and publishers alike navigated the transitional period before the grand arrival of *GTA6*.

### Fierce Competition on PS5

Despite the overarching anticipation for the next Grand Theft Auto installment, developers and publishers did not hold back. October delivered a staggering number of new PS5 titles, keeping players glued to their controllers through a relentless schedule of high-profile launches.

This crowded release landscape made the latest Game of the Month poll hosted by Push Square all the more intriguing. When the dust settled and the community votes were tallied, *Phantom Blade Zero* emerged victorious, capturing the coveted title for October.

### Shining Bright Amidst the Hype

Securing the top spot during such a congested month is no small feat. *Phantom Blade Zero* managed to stand out among a packed field of contenders, proving through community votes that its unique style and action-heavy gameplay struck a major chord with PS5 owners looking for top-tier experiences while waiting for the industry's ultimate blockbuster.

While market analysts often debate how subsequent games can survive the marketing oxygen sucked up by a title like *GTA6*, October proved that players are still more than willing to embrace and celebrate exceptional releases right up until the finish line.

## Editor's Take

It is fascinating to watch the gaming ecosystem adapt in the shadow of *GTA6*. October 2026 could have easily been completely overshadowed, yet the sheer volume and quality of PS5 releases kept the momentum alive. *Phantom Blade Zero* taking the Game of the Month crown is a testament to strong development and an eager audience hungry for elite action titles while the clock ticks down.
